protocol: official Text4Seg refer_seg harness (model_refer_seg -> eval_refer_seg): cIoU = sum intersection / sum union over referring expressions; mIoU = mean per-expression IoU; masks from generated R-RLE text and SAM-H refinement. n = number of referring expressions in the official RefCOCO val split.
env: conda glod-ris: Python 3.10, torch 2.2.1+cu121, transformers 4.49.0; model lmc22/text4seg-llava-7b-p24 (HuggingFace, released quick-inference checkpoint); SAM ViT-H
